# DealGapIQ

> DealGapIQ is a residential real estate deal analysis platform that scores investment properties across six acquisition strategies (Long-Term Rental, Short-Term Rental, BRRRR, Fix & Flip, House Hack, Wholesale) and surfaces the Deal Gap — the distance between the asking price and the price an investor should actually offer.

Founded by Brad Geisen — founder of Foreclosure.com (1999) — DealGapIQ blends data from Zillow, RentCast, Redfin, Realtor.com, and AirROI with its own IQ Estimate model. The platform is built for active residential investors who want a fast, transparent Discovery on any property.

## Core entry points

- [Homepage](https://dealgapiq.com/): product overview and instant property scanner
- [About](https://dealgapiq.com/about): founder story, methodology philosophy, and the three proprietary metrics (Target Buy, Income Value, Deal Gap)
- [Pricing](https://dealgapiq.com/pricing): Starter (free) and Pro ($29.17/mo billed annually, or $34.99/mo, with 7-day free trial)
- [What is DealGapIQ](https://dealgapiq.com/what-is-dealgapiq): plain-English overview of the platform

## Product

- [Discovery](https://dealgapiq.com/discovery): instant deal score (0–95) for any address with ranked strategy recommendations
- [Strategy](https://dealgapiq.com/strategy): full financial deep-dive — cash flow, NOI, DSCR, sensitivity analysis, 10-year projections
- [DealMaker](https://dealgapiq.com/deal-maker): editable assumptions, four pre-built offer structures, and AI-generated negotiation scripts

## Glossary

- [Glossary index](https://dealgapiq.com/glossary): plain-English definitions of creative-finance structures used by active investors

## Blog

- [Blog index](https://dealgapiq.com/blog): deal teardowns, creative-finance breakdowns, financing comparisons, and pitch scripts (RSS: https://dealgapiq.com/blog/feed.xml)
- [Creative Finance](https://dealgapiq.com/blog/category/creative-finance): Subject-To, seller carrybacks, wraps, lease options, Morby Method
- [Deal Analysis](https://dealgapiq.com/blog/category/deal-analysis): underwriting rentals, cap rate vs cash-on-cash, DSCR, ARV, the Deal Gap
- [Offers & Negotiation](https://dealgapiq.com/blog/category/offers-negotiation): offer structures and seller pitch scripts
- [Financing](https://dealgapiq.com/blog/category/financing): hard money, DSCR loans, private money, refinance seasoning
- [Strategies](https://dealgapiq.com/blog/category/strategies): LTR, STR, BRRRR, fix & flip, house hack, wholesale compared
- [Markets](https://dealgapiq.com/blog/category/markets): reading a local market before you offer

## Markets

- [Investor market data by state](https://dealgapiq.com/markets): per-state property tax rate, vacancy, appreciation, and rent-to-price assumptions used by DealGapIQ, plus lender and cash-buyer counts (one page per state at /markets/{state-name})
